summary: Phase 1 Foundation verified end-to-end. Backend: 16/16 pytest passed (roles, register, login, me, admin RBAC, all 401/403/409/422 cases). Frontend: all UI flows pass EXCEPT the sign-out transition. I fixed 2 critical blockers: (1) API client used Constants.expoConfig.extra.backendUrl which is NULL on Expo web -> 'Backend URL is not configured' blocked every API call; switched to process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. (2) Sign-out crashed the app with 'Maximum update depth exceeded' (double navigation: router.replace in onPress + Redirect render); crash eliminated, but sign-out now lands on a BLANK screen (tab bar only, no content) until page reload - residual navigation-structure bug for main agent.

ui_bugs.issue: After sign-out, app navigates to '/' but renders a BLANK screen (bottom tab bar visible, empty content). Auth screen only appears after manual page reload. Root cause: ambiguous '/' route shared by app/index.tsx and app/(tabs)/index.tsx plus per-screen redirect guards racing. Original code CRASHED with 'Maximum update depth exceeded' (router.replace in onPress + <Redirect> both firing); I applied a stopgap (useEffect-based guard) that removes the crash but not the blank screen.

"teach" is not a valid MaterialCommunityIcons name - Trainer icon renders as '?' placeholder. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/role-selector.tsx:9 and /app/frontend/src/screens/home-screen.tsx:13

rca_of_issue: BUG 1 (fixed): 'Backend URL is not configured' on all web API calls. Repro: open preview, register any user. Cause: client.ts read Constants.expoConfig.extra.backendUrl; expo-constants web shim (ExponentConstants.web.js) exposes no expoConfig and no manifest is injected into Metro-served HTML, so the value was null. Fix: use process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (Metro inlines EXPO_PUBLIC_* at bundle time on all platforms), Constants kept as native fallback. Mitigation verified: register/login flows work on web. BUG 2 (partially fixed): sign-out crash 'Maximum update depth exceeded'. Repro: sign in -> Profile tab -> Sign out. Cause: profile-screen onPress called router.replace('/') AND rendered <Redirect href='/'> when user became null (Redirect's useFocusEffect fires router.replace inside layout effect -> navigation store forceStoreRerender loop). Stopgap applied: removed router.replace from onPress, converted per-screen <Redirect> to useEffect guard -> crash gone, but navigation to '/' resolves ambiguously (app/index.tsx and app/(tabs)/index.tsx share path '/') leaving a blank tabs-layout screen until reload. Permanent fix left to main agent (see action_items).
